author: Bryan Guffey
message:
feat: linkify organizer mentions via aturi.to profile waypoint

Every 'DM @chaosgreml.in' mention (hero invite-only + closed notes, sign-in
sheet denial, review closed note) and the hero author line now link to
https://aturi.to/profile/<did> — no cross-client DM deep link exists, so
the aturi.to landing lets each visitor open the profile (Message one tap
away) in their own Atmosphere client. DID not handle so the link survives
handle changes. The sheet's denial message became a structured snippet so
the mention could be a real anchor.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
feat: pre-flight invite check on handle submit — uninvited handles learn before the PDS auth dance

New GET /api/invited?handle= resolves the handle to a DID (so pinned DIDs
still match after handle changes) and peeks the allowlist read-only. The
sign-in sheet calls it before login(); an uninvited handle gets the polite
invite-only note inline instead of a full OAuth round-trip. Every failure
mode (endpoint down, resolution failed, no DB) fails open — real
enforcement stays server-side after auth.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: enforce allowlist at sign-in, not just submit

A non-invited account (e.g. atproto.la) could sign in and browse the whole
survey, only hitting the allowlist 403 at final submit. The page load now
checks the allowlist too: non-invited sign-ins keep the feed sealed and see
the polite invite-only note on the hero (with sign-out). The API still
enforces on write as defense in depth.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
feat: smoke-test feedback round — locked pre-auth feed, next affordances, ZIP lookup, handle typeahead, welcome-back, numeric-globe favicon

1. Signed-out feed is sealed at the hero: no scroll, rail dimmed to a faint
   map, dots hidden; everything unlocks at sign-in.
2. Every question grows a Next chip when answered; Enter advances (fields
   chain name→email→location→next).
3. Location field resolves 5-digit ZIPs to 'City, ST' via zippopotam.us,
   graceful fallback to free text.
4. Sign-in handle field is a typeahead (typeahead.waow.tech, debounced,
   keyboard-navigable, opens upward from the bottom sheet; degrades to a
   plain input if the experimental service is down). A 180-day identity-hint
   cookie greets returning visitors — 'Hey, it's you' — with one-tap
   continue, surviving logout.
5. Favicon: original numeric-globe homage to atproto.com's ASCII Earth.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: resolve workerd export conditions in Vite SSR build

Vite's SSR resolver defaults to node conditions, baking @atcute's
node-flavored builds (bare Buffer.prototype.base64urlSlice.call) into the
worker bundle; workerd's stricter Buffer polyfill throws 'The "start"
argument must be of type number' on every OAuth login. Resolve with
workerd/worker conditions so the packages' own pure-JS web builds ship.

Root-caused from Bryan's smoke-test HAR + local workerd repro.
